<reason>Side A prevailed by exposing the fatal asymmetry in Side B's position: B conceded buyers can only perform "sanity checks" against "obvious fakes" while high-grade counterfeits fool ordinary shoppers, yet B argued platforms should keep commissions while buyers absorb total losses.
